context: Tests whether the agent builds only the Angular UI layer of UC-010 on top of the API Handover it is given: a TypeScript model that mirrors ProductDto field by field (including the nullable imageUrl and without the entity-only inStock field), a hand-written HttpClient service calling exactly the handed-over endpoints, a standalone page with signal state, no client-side duplicate of BR-001, the Markers table maintained, and a Handover block at the end.

checklist.name: Model mirrors the DTO field by field
checklist.description: A TypeScript interface for the product has exactly the fields id, name, category, price, imageUrl with types number, string, string, number, string | null — imageUrl is typed nullable, no field is renamed

checklist.name: No entity-only field in the model
checklist.description: The model does not contain inStock (it is an entity attribute the DTO does not expose)

checklist.name: Service calls the handed-over endpoints
checklist.description: A hand-written injectable service uses HttpClient to call GET /api/products with an optional category query parameter and GET /api/products/categories — no invented endpoint, no generated client

checklist.name: Standalone page with signals
checklist.description: ProductCatalog stays a standalone component (no NgModule, no declarations) and holds its state (products, categories, selected category or loading) in signal()/computed()

checklist.name: Category filter and empty state
checklist.description: The template renders a labelled category select that reloads or narrows the products (A1) and an empty-state message when no product matches (A2)

checklist.name: BR-001 not re-implemented in the client
checklist.description: The UI does not filter on inStock itself and puts no UC-010 BR-001 marker in the frontend — the service layer enforces the rule

checklist.name: Use case id on the page
checklist.description: The ProductCatalog component class carries a UC-010 class comment (e.g. /** UC-010: Browse Product Catalog */)

checklist.name: Markers table maintained
checklist.description: docs/architecture/stack.md's Markers table has the angular-ui rows of the skill's markers reference (page class comment, form-validator BR marker, naming of page/service/model); the outdated angular-ui row is corrected; the All row is unchanged; nothing else in docs/ is edited

checklist.name: Layer boundaries respected
checklist.description: No file under backend/ is created or changed, and no *.spec.ts test file is created

checklist.name: Handover block
checklist.description: The final report ends with a 'Handover from angular-ui (UC-010)' block naming the route, the service methods with their endpoints, the model, and the labels/messages
